findings.title: The generic U1 record declares COMPLETE while its required cold deep-entry check remains unobserved
findings.counterexample: The unchanged original N16 record declares coverage=COMPLETE and observation_coverage=COMPLETE while its initial entry/state scope lists required G1. Frozen gates.md:22 requires direct navigation to applicable stateful URLs and reload; SKILL.md:11-12 and run-evidence.md:36,48 prohibit treating a missing required capability as non-applicability. The actual three commands all start at https://qaizen.io/labs; all readiness entries are clicks, and observation-3/actions.json:3-7 performs click then reload, followed by history checks, with no direct URL navigation. The initial scope-plan.json:112 names absence of a relay deep-navigation action as the limitation, not a source-based exclusion. This reproduces a recorded required-coverage gap despite the actual successful reload/history observations; justified assessed coverage is PARTIAL. It does not establish a website failure or require inventing a new cold-cache condition.
